user_scope_confirmation.owner_data_use: Split the available owner data by episode/time order and use the untouched portion as an independent time-ordered holdout.
user_scope_confirmation.externality_rule: Do not label a same-site owner holdout as independent external validation; retain the public Type-IV holdout as the independent external component lane.
user_scope_confirmation.station_to_vehicle_goal: Remove synchronized station-to-vehicle raw validation from the primary goal and disclose the missing reusable public bundle as a paper limitation.
user_scope_confirmation.ethics_and_expert_review: Keep human-subject ethics determination and independent expert review out of the physics-paper gate; require them only before claiming SAGA improves human safety decisions.

owner_station_side_time_ordered_holdout.claim_boundary: Same-site station-side pressure, cascade and recharge diagnostics only; no vehicle-side or field-safety claim.

public_type_iv_component_holdout.claim_boundary: Independent external receiving-tank component evidence only; no station controller, dispenser, ESD, vehicle or field-safety claim.

search_boundary: pressure, temperature and mass-flow or transferred-mass fields

reviewed_leads.note: Paper describes station, hose and vehicle channels, but no public machine-readable logger archive or reuse terms were found.
Station DAQ and pressure/dispensing summaries are described; a synchronized raw station-to-vehicle export is not published.

The local sample workbook has common-clock hose and seven-tank pressure/temperature/mass channels, but no station-controller/cascade, ESD/interlock, nozzle/receptacle or vehicle-protocol trace; internal-use data policy prevents redistribution.
Layout and aggregate/availability signals are public; vehicle-tank transient channels and a common station-to-vehicle clock are absent.

station_to_vehicle_public_search.paper_limitation: No openly reusable synchronized station-to-vehicle raw trace was identified; vehicle-side controller/ESD and complete full-loop field validation are outside the claim boundary.
station_to_vehicle_public_search.optional_reentry: Custodian-provided, de-identified, synchronized events may be frozen and evaluated as a separately scoped extension.

ethics_and_expert_evaluation.ethics_meaning: Institutional determination of approval, exemption or not-required status for a human-facing study.
ethics_and_expert_evaluation.expert_meaning: Independent blinded qualified reviewers score SAGA versus alarm-only responses for action correctness, priority, stabilization, prevention, grounding, usability and unsafe omissions; no LLM-as-judge.
ethics_and_expert_evaluation.deployment_requirement: Facility-specific ethics determination and qualified independent expert review are required before deployment or any claim of human safety-effectiveness; this is outside the primary physics-paper gate.
ethics_and_expert_evaluation.basis_materials: Initial safety and response materials are drafted from Korea Gas Safety Corporation (KGS)-collected data with AI assistance; authors verify quantitative outputs, references and final claims.
ethics_and_expert_evaluation.publication_claim_limit: The paper reports objective engineering/model evidence and traceable direct-answer generation only; it does not claim operator improvement, universal facility suitability or regulatory compliance.
